selected_evidence.requirement: node2/node3 connect through node1 via separate private networks
selected_evidence.summary: Topology discovery: node1 has eth1/eth2 unaddressed NICs, node2/node3 have unaddressed ens7 NICs, confirming separate private links routed through node1

selected_evidence.requirement: Static addressing and routing established for the private links
selected_evidence.summary: VyOS interface config committed/saved on node1; persistent ifupdown configs written on node2/node3; end-to-end ping node2->node3 succeeds

selected_evidence.requirement: Traffic from node2 toward node3 limited to 1 Mbit/s
selected_evidence.summary: iperf3 baseline (~20 Gbit/s) before shaping; VyOS qos policy shaper committed on eth2 egress; tc shows HTB class rate/ceil 1Mbit; post-config iperf3 node2->node3 measures ~957 Kbit/s

selected_evidence.requirement: Traffic from node3 toward node2 remains unrestricted
selected_evidence.summary: iperf3 node3->node2 measures ~1.05 Gbit/s, confirming the reverse direction is unaffected by the shaper
